description: Self-hosted Renovate, run daily from console-vm (scripts/renovate-run.sh, Cronicle-triggered). Every image bump is opened as its own PR and AUTOMERGED by Renovate itself after a per-tier release age -- nobody clicks merge (decision of 2026-09-16). Merge = deploy via Argo CD; the iac-gate CronJob (iac-gate/) watches every Renovate commit for 15 minutes after it lands and reverts it on a red app or a red Kuma monitor, then appends an auto-block rule here so the same version is not re-proposed for 30 days. renovate-run.sh prunes expired auto-blocks before each run. This repo has no status checks, hence ignoreTests: the gate after the merge is the test.

packageRules.description: Digest, pin and patch bumps merge as soon as Renovate sees them again (next daily run). The gate is the test.
Minors wait 3 days upstream, then merge. One PR per image so a revert targets one image.

Majors wait 14 days upstream, then merge. A major that breaks is caught by the gate and blocked for 30 days; the Dependency Dashboard approval that used to hold them was the one manual step left (lesson of 2026-07-31, retired 2026-09-16).

Fragile list: images whose minors have carried config/schema changes (Frigate, Loki, Argo CD, the UniFi mongo). Minors wait 14 days, majors 30 -- the community finds the regressions first. Still automerged; the gate still reverts.
Database majors never come from a bot: mongo upgrades are one-major-at-a-time maintenances with an FCV runbook (see history.md 2026-07-31)
